headlines.title: Pennsylvania warns of rise in congenital measles and infection during pregnancy
headlines.description: The Pennsylvania Department of Health issued an alert Monday to doctors about an increase in measles infections in pregnant women, as well as a concerning rise in congenital measles — a disease that’s rarely, if ever, seen in the U.S.

headlines.title: Christina Applegate says she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis
headlines.description: Christina Applegate announced Tuesday that she had been misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie — next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: New gene therapy gives some kids born deaf the ability to hear
headlines.description: A new gene therapy is now giving some children born deaf the ability to hear. NBC’s Dr. Akshay Syal breaks down the remarkable breakthrough and the kind of hearing loss it can help treat.

headlines.title: Fighting Fatigue: Tips to Overcome the 'Afternoon Slump'
headlines.description: Tired of feeling tired? NBC medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar and TODAY nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer join the 3rd Hour of TODAY to break down tips for overcoming fatigue. They discuss the differences between feeling tired versus fatigued, the potential causes of fatigue and share tips for pushing through the afternoon slump.

headlines.title: How does hypnotherapy actually work, and what can it treat?
headlines.description: With a wave of TikTok hypnotists promising help with everything from anxiety to weight loss, interest in the practice of hypnotherapy is on the rise. NBC News’ Chloe Melas does a deep dive into the facts and even gets hypnotized herself.

headlines.title: Menopause and Perimenopause: Latest Research and Treatments
headlines.description: Menopause and perimenopause affects millions of women every year, yet they only receive a tiny fraction of federal research funding. But with demand for care on the rise, that longstanding gap in women’s health is starting to close. Board-certified OBGYN Dr. Mary Claire Haver joins TODAY with a checklist of the latest treatments and research findings.

headlines.title: Sitting all day? These neck stretchers are the ultimate cure for ‘tech neck’
headlines.description: I found the best cervical traction devices, aka neck stretchers, to help relieve neck pain and promote better posture.

headlines.title: How long does your food last in the fridge during a power outage? Experts explain
headlines.description: Two food safety experts explain how long your fridge and freezer will keep food safe during a power outage, the warning signs it’s time to toss it, and how to prep before the next outage hits.

headlines.title: 17 best deals from Amazon’s Holiday Beauty Event, according to a beauty editor
headlines.description: We rounded up the best deals on skin care, makeup, hair care and more from Amazon’s Holiday Beauty Event, including favorites from Medicube, Tarte, Clinique and more.

headlines.title: How to watch the 2026 NBA season even if you don’t have cable
headlines.description: Here’s everything you need to know about the 2026 NBA season, including when it starts and where to watch or stream the games.
